title: Cinematic Video Prompt Builder Output
description: Structured JSON output contract for a polished cinematic video prompt package. This schema applies only when response_format = structured_json.

storytelling_resolution.description: Machine-readable resolution of the storytelling controls after auto-inference, conflict repair, and cinematic consolidation.

reference_notes.description: Reference notes used to keep identity, character traits, environment anchors, props, or composition stable. This may refer to uploaded @ImageN handles, or to inferred character/environment details when no images were attached.
Per-prompt reference notes. Use uploaded @ImageN handles only when images exist; otherwise preserve the scene through concise character or environment anchor details inferred from the brief.

shot_timeline.description: Optional internal timed shot breakdown for a single multi-shot video. Present this when the user provided explicit timed shots or when the resolved output would clearly benefit from exposing the inferred internal shot schedule.
